title: Rest for the weary
body:
> Come unto me, all ye that labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.
> — Matthew 11:28 KJV

A full week behind me and a fuller one ahead. The invitation isn't to try harder but to come, and to take His yoke, which Matthew 11:29 says is easy.

### Where else rest is promised

- Isaiah 40, verse 31: they that wait upon the LORD shall renew their strength.
- Psalm 23 — He maketh me to lie down in green pastures.
- Hebrews chapter 4:9 - 11: there remaineth therefore a rest to the people of God.

Lord, teach me to come to You first, before the list, before the noise. Amen.

title: The light of the world
body: Jesus says in John 8:12 that whoever follows Him shall not walk in darkness. In John Chapter 9 He shows it, giving sight to a man born blind.

title: Morning praise
body: Make a joyful noise unto the LORD, all ye lands (Psalm 100:1).
